patch_description: Replace the per-sample Kalman + Holt cascade (which incurs lag on trend segments and only achieves 0.33 noise reduction / 103 slope changes) with a vectorized Savitzky-Golay (order-2 polynomial) FIR smoother convolved with an exponentially decaying recency-weighting kernel (e^-1.5 tilt). The polynomial fit preserves local trend dynamics (low lag, good tracking), the recency tilt shifts effective weight toward the most recent samples to cut group delay, and the convolution is fully vectorized via np.convolve "valid" mode preserving the 1.00 efficiency score. A post-pass zero-phase slope gate suppresses noise-induced false reversals by detecting slope sign flips smaller than a local noise threshold and re-integrating the gated slopes. This directly targets slope_changes (103), false_reversals (85.4), and lag_error (0.42) simultaneously.
